basic_details.offering_entity: Alliance of International Science Organizations (ANSO) & Chinese Academy of Sciences (CAS)
basic_details.host_institutions_covered: University of Science and Technology of China (USTC) & University of Chinese Academy of Sciences (UCAS) and over 100 CAS research institutes across China
basic_details.major_restrictions: Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics, and Medicine (STEM): Physical Sciences, Chemical Sciences, Life Sciences, Earth & Environmental Sciences, Computer Science, AI, Materials Science, Engineering.
basic_details.number_of_awards_pakistan: Open to Pakistan as a founding member country of ANSO (~50 to 80 Pakistani scholars selected annually)
basic_details.duration_of_scholarship: Up to 36 months for Master's; up to 48 months for PhD

nationality_requirements: Non-Chinese citizens of an eligible country (Pakistani citizens eligible)
eligibility_requirements.age_limit_notes: Master's applicants: maximum 30 years of age; PhD applicants: maximum 35 years of age on December 31 of award year.
eligibility_requirements.academic_qualifications: 16 years of education (Bachelor's) for Master's; 18 years (Master's) for PhD from an HEC-recognized institution.
eligibility_requirements.grading_conversion_notes: Minimum 3.00 / 4.00 CGPA or equivalent; admitted scholars typically present 3.50+ CGPA.
eligibility_requirements.subject_background_prerequisites: Undergraduate or postgraduate degree in natural sciences, engineering, or computing.
eligibility_requirements.current_education_status: Graduated or in final semester of degree.
eligibility_requirements.work_experience_notes: Research publications in international peer-reviewed journals (SCI/EI indexed) carry decisive weight.

english_proficiency.notes: IELTS Academic 6.5+, TOEFL iBT 90+, or official English Proficiency Certificate (Medium of Instruction - MOI) issued by university registrar.

eligibility_requirements.other_language_requirements: Chinese language (HSK) not mandatory for English-taught programs.
eligibility_requirements.special_eligibility_categories: Candidates MUST find a host supervisor at USTC or UCAS/CAS institute who agrees to accept them.
eligibility_requirements.previous_scholarship_restrictions: Ineligible if currently enrolled in a Chinese university or holding another Chinese government scholarship.

tuition_fee.details: 100% full tuition waiver for the entire duration of the degree program at USTC or UCAS.

admission_application_fee.details: Application fee waived by host institutions for ANSO applicants.

accommodation.details: Free on-campus dormitory accommodation (single room for PhD, shared room for Master's) or off-campus housing subsidy.

monthly_stipend.details: Generous monthly living allowance paid directly to scholar.
monthly_stipend.amount: Master's: RMB 3,000 / month (~PKR 115,000 / month); PhD: RMB 6,000 to 7,000 / month (~PKR 230,000 to 270,000 / month)

airfare.details: International travel subsidy provided (one round-trip flight from home country to China).

visa_fee.details: Chinese student visa (X1) application fee paid by student at Chinese Visa Application Service Centre (Gerry's) in Pakistan.

health_insurance.details: Comprehensive Medical Insurance for Foreign Students in China provided (RMB 800/year).

research_funding_conference_grant.details: Full access to state key laboratories and research project funding through the Chinese Academy of Sciences.

travel_transit_allowance.details: One-time settlement subsidy provided upon initial arrival.

university_and_program_options.single_or_multiple_universities: Apply to either University of Science and Technology of China (USTC) or University of Chinese Academy of Sciences (UCAS).
participating_institutions: University of Science and Technology of China (USTC - Hefei)
University of Chinese Academy of Sciences (UCAS - Beijing)
Over 100 CAS Research Institutes (Institute of Physics, Institute of Automation, Shanghai Institute of Optics, etc.)
university_and_program_options.university_rankings_scope: USTC is World Top 60 (Nature Index Top 5 globally); CAS is World #1 research organization in Nature Index.
available_majors: Artificial Intelligence, Computer Science, Quantum Information, Condensed Matter Physics, Chemistry, Materials Science, Environmental Sciences, Biology, Mechanical Engineering, Automation, Astronomy, Earth Sciences
university_and_program_options.program_duration: Up to 3 years for Master's; up to 4 years for PhD
university_and_program_options.admission_requirements_summary: Contact prospective supervisor at USTC or UCAS to secure Provisional Acceptance Form; then apply via the university international student portal.
university_and_program_options.easiest_hardest_institutions_guidance: Securing supervisor acceptance is the key hurdle; once a professor accepts you, scholarship conversion is very high.
university_and_program_options.strategic_program_match_advice: Search CAS research institutes directly; contacting faculty whose research matches your thesis publications yields the best response.

application_process_roadmap.portal_system_name: USTC / UCAS International Online Application System
application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Register on the USTC or UCAS online portal (Opens October/November), select 'ANSO Scholarship for Young Talents', and upload supervisor acceptance.
step_by_step_workflow: 1. Identify CAS/USTC faculty members in your research field and email them with your CV and publications (October-December).
2. Secure the signed 'Provisional Acceptance of International Student by Professor' form.
3. Create account on USTC portal (isa.ustc.edu.cn) or UCAS portal (admission.ucas.ac.cn).
4. Select ANSO Scholarship and upload academic degrees, transcripts, research proposal, and references.
6. Academic review and expert panel evaluations take place in March/April.
7. Final ANSO scholarship results announced in May/June; JW202 visa forms issued.
application_process_roadmap.university_vs_scholarship_routing: Combined single application via USTC or UCAS portal.
application_process_roadmap.recommendation_letters_submission_method: Submitted online by two professors via email link sent by the admission system.
application_process_roadmap.personal_statement_prompts: Study Plan / Research Proposal (minimum 800 words for Master's, 1,500 words for PhD) describing research goals and background.
application_process_roadmap.study_plan_research_proposal_requirement: Detailed research plan detailing research background, objectives, experimental design, and expected results.
application_process_roadmap.cv_format_requirements: Detailed academic CV with full list of research publications (DOI links, impact factors).
application_process_roadmap.interview_format_details: Host research group and departmental panel conduct 20-30 minute technical video interview via Zoom/Voov.
application_process_roadmap.standardized_tests: GRE not required; English language certificate required.
application_process_roadmap.attestation_requirements: Degrees and transcripts must be notarized; HEC and MOFA attestation required for final enrollment.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Official form signed by prospective USTC or UCAS supervisor
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Critical gatekeeper document; required for submission

required_documents_checklist.specification: Notarized copies of Bachelor's and Master's degrees and complete transcripts
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Attested by HEC Pakistan and notarized

required_documents_checklist.specification: Letters from professors or associate professors on university letterhead
Official Chinese physical examination form signed and stamped by doctor
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Issued by registered government hospital with blood test reports
Issued by local Pakistani police department / Police Khidmat Markaz

important_dates_timeline.annual_cycle_notes: Application deadline is strictly mid-February each year. Final results released late May to June.

selection_process_and_weights.academic_weight: 35% (Academic background, grades, prestige of home university)
selection_process_and_weights.research_experience_weight: 40% (SCI indexed publications, research proposal quality, laboratory skills)
selection_process_and_weights.selection_panel_composition: Joint evaluation by host institute professors, university international student committees, and the ANSO Secretariat.
selection_process_and_weights.evaluation_methodology: Two-tier review: Host supervisor accepts candidate; central ANSO scientific committee reviews and approves award.

competitiveness_profile.total_annual_applicants: ~6,000+ applicants across all ANSO partner countries
competitiveness_profile.acceptance_rate_pakistan: ~5% to 7% (Very favorable for candidates with published research)
competitiveness_profile.typical_academic_and_research_profile: Graduates with at least 1 or 2 published peer-reviewed journal papers in international journals.
competitiveness_profile.common_backgrounds_of_winners: Graduates of Pakistani universities (NUST, Quaid-i-Azam, COMSATS, UET Lahore, Punjab University) with strong lab experience.
competitiveness_profile.high_representation_countries: Pakistan, Russia, Kazakhstan, Thailand, Egypt, Iran, Nepal, Kenya.

fake_websites_and_scams: Agents claiming they can guarantee ANSO supervisor acceptance for PKR 200,000+.
red_flags_and_warnings.application_fee_warning: ANSO application is 100% free of charge.
red_flags_and_warnings.agent_and_intermediary_warnings: Never hire agents; prospective professors communicate only with the candidate directly.
hidden_costs_breakdown: Police clearance and medical checkup fees in Pakistan (~PKR 15,000).
Initial pocket money before first stipend release in Hefei or Beijing.
misleading_claims_debunked: MYTH: You cannot apply without an HSK Chinese certificate. (Fact: Programs are taught 100% in English; no Chinese test required).
MYTH: You can apply without contacting a professor. (Fact: Applications without supervisor acceptance are rejected).
official_vs_unofficial_discrepancies: Some websites advertise this as CSC; ANSO is an independent flagship program with higher PhD stipends (up to RMB 7,000/month vs CSC RMB 3,500/month).

scholarship_obligations_and_terms.minimum_gpa_maintenance: Must pass all required graduate coursework and achieve satisfactory annual progress in research milestones.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.attendance_requirements: Full-time physical research attendance at host CAS institute in China.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.academic_progress_monitoring: Annual scholarship review conducted by host supervisor and academic committee.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.work_restrictions_during_study: Off-campus employment is restricted under Chinese X1 visa rules without university authorization.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.home_country_return_obligation: None; scholars can pursue postdoctoral research in China or internationally.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.service_obligations_or_bonds: None; expected to acknowledge ANSO in research publications.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.repayment_clawback_conditions: Failing annual review or violation of Chinese laws leads to immediate termination.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_major: Requires approval from host supervisor and university.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.extension_policy: Extensions are strictly granted only under exceptional circumstances approved by the ANSO Secretariat.
